nodes.label: The iOS slop test (fluency heuristic)
nodes.rationale: Would a fluent iPhone user trust this app, or pause at off-spec controls? Default to platform components; depart only for a reason the user would thank you for.

nodes.label: Squint test (reading-order/hierarchy heuristic)
nodes.rationale: With detail blurred, can you still identify the primary element, secondary element, and major groups in order? Used both to plan and to verify layout structure.

nodes.label: Identity lock (Phase A identity extraction before variant generation)
nodes.rationale: Live runs on an existing surface with an already-chosen brand; variants must vary within identity, not select between identities, since three off-brand variants the user cannot accept is the worst failure.
nodes.norm_label: identity lock (phase a identity extraction before variant generation)

nodes.label: The standing exit (category-standard fallback direction)
nodes.rationale: Every direction round offers one quiet permanent alternative, the category standard played straight, so the user always has a safe door that the model never recommends or weighs against the roll.
